validation.independent_review: Java agent inspected source and reproduced/fixed delayed rejection with unchanged standalone probe; no Windows runtime claim

limitations: Counters include the host JVM, one selector peer, test callbacks and provider; RSS is not Windows private commit.
Blocked worker/socket figures are fresh-JVM observations. Parked/transient workers can exceed active requests, within the136-thread unary pool ceiling.
Post-release draining is slower because queued connections start after the peer is released; baseline has opened every connection before release.
Initial URL/header admission charge is not an exact retained heap or total response/header/cache/body-byte budget.
Existing H2, URLConnection, DNS and account workers are separate. An application can hold its active read/redirect slot until it continues or cancels.
The noisy run including its2.45-second one-request outlier is preserved; pauses in other local lane builds reduce, but do not prove absence of, shared-host noise.
